name: Per (Herreper)
description: The youngest brother who starts with nothing but a cat, then is presented to the king as the grand lord Herreper and rides a wave of the cat’s schemes into sudden power.
visualPrompt: A young Nordic farm boy with tousled hair and a wary, earnest face, initially in worn patched clothes and simple boots; later shown in lavish, gold-trimmed finery that looks almost too grand for him, his posture a mix of humility and startled confidence.

name: Katten (fortryllet prinsesse)
description: A fiercely intelligent cat who hunts grand gifts, engineers the Herreper deception, and ultimately reveals herself as an enchanted princess once the troll is defeated.
visualPrompt: A sleek gray cat with bright, commanding eyes and a poised, imperious stance, appearing uncannily clever; hints of hidden royalty in subtle details like a graceful bearing and an almost crown-like tufting around the head, with an aura of contained magic.

name: Kongen
description: A proud ruler delighted by extravagant gifts, increasingly suspicious of Herreper’s boasts, and driven to see the truth for himself.
visualPrompt: A middle-aged king in a heavy, ornate cloak with fur trim, wearing a simple but authoritative crown; his expression shifts between pleased greed, curiosity, and simmering irritation, hands clasped as if weighing pride against wonder.

name: Troldet
description: The brutal owner of the shining castle, undone by the cat’s cunning when sunlight turns him to ruin.
visualPrompt: A hulking troll with rough, stone-like skin and a broad, shadowed face, looming at a grand gate with clenched fists; his presence feels heavy and oppressive, as if darkness gathers around him even in daylight.
